{{Quote|The Mon Calamari live on a water-covered world. One of their favorite desserts is crab-stuffed creampuffs. With live crabs.|Dash Rendar, to Zak Arranda|<ref name="Doom" />}}
'''Crab-stuffed creampuffs''' were a type o [[Foodstuff|pastry]] enjoyed by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Doom" /> who were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Dac" /> The treats were similar to cream-stuffed pastries but were filled with live [[Crab/Legends|crabs]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], crab-stuffed creampuffs were served at the [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration of the Mon Calamari [[Bobringi Mafusa]] on the luxury [[Starship/Legends|star-cruiser]] ''[[Star of Empire]]'', but when the ship was evacuated because of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] troubles, the leftover creampuffs were abandoned. After the evacuation of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]] found a platter of the creampuffs and eagerly bit into one of the desserts despite being warned not to by his companion [[Dash Rendar]]. To Arranda's dismay, his [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] was filled with tiny, live crabs, so he spit the creampuff out while shaking the [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]] off himself.<ref name="Doom" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TinyDeathStar-CrabCreampuff.png|thumb|right|120px|alt=|A pixelated yellow circle with a white line through the middle against a gray background.|Crab-stuffed creampuffs as depicted in ''Tiny Death Star'']]
Crab-stuffed creampuffs appeared in the tenth installment of [[John Whitman]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Fear]]'' young reader series, [[Galaxy of Fear: The Doomsday Ship|''The Doomsday Ship'']], published in [[1998]].<ref name="Doom" /> The creampuffs were first pictured when they appeared in the [[2013]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', developed by [[Disney Mobile]]. They were depicted as white filling sandwiched between two buns. They were sold for 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at the "Mon Cala Seafood" food level in the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star I]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="TDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
